description: Assemble G2-recorded and public (CS-FLEURS, SwitchLingua, MLC-SLM, FLEURS) test audio covering: monolingual non-English, inter-sentential switching between speakers/lines, and intra-sentential mixing (priority pairs e.g. en/ja, en/es, en/zh). Metrics: WER/MER per language, LID accuracy per utterance and per token, switch-point detection latency (live), and wrong-script/hallucinated-translation rate.
title: Build multilingual and code-switched evaluation set and metrics
